title: Scheduler accepts POSIX cron string and one-shot delayed
asA: developer scheduling a job to run every minute (POSIX cron) or once after a delay
iWant: the scheduler surface to accept both a POSIX cron string and a one-shot delayed shape (delayMs or fireAt) and publish the corresponding message to the applied queue at the elicited fire time
soThat: one contract covers both recurring and deferred sends without a second scheduler surface

acceptanceCriteria.description: The scheduler under packages/rcf-lite/test/fixtures/infra-s3-and-queue/src/scheduler.mjs accepts a POSIX cron string on a job definition (refresh-cache.mjs carries cron: '* * * * *') and publishes a message to the applied queue when the fake-clock advances past the fire time. The scheduler also accepts a one-shot delayed schedule (delayMs) and publishes when the fake-clock advances past the fireAt time.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the fixture scheduler booted in inProcess mode with a fake-clock seam
acceptanceCriteria.when: the fake clock advances one POSIX cron minute or past a scheduled delayMs
acceptanceCriteria.then: one message per fire lands on the applied in-memory queue with the target job.name and an ISO-8601 timestamp

acceptanceCriteria.description: Malformed cron string refused. Given a job definition scheduled with a cron string that does not match a POSIX cron shape (missing a field, or an out-of-range value), when the scheduler validates the schedule, then the scheduler refuses with a named error kind (malformedCronExpression) and the job does not register into the schedule; jobScheduled does not fire.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a job scheduled with a malformed cron string
acceptanceCriteria.then: the scheduler refuses with malformedCronExpression; the job does not register; jobScheduled does not fire

acceptanceCriteria.description: Scheduler mode workerCron. Given the elicited scheduler-mode answers workerCron and the applied deploy-cloudflare-workers target carries at least one job with a cron string, when the sidecar records the answer, then the generated wrangler.toml carries a `[triggers] crons = ["<cron-string>"]` entry per scheduled job (one entry per distinct cron string) and the Worker's `scheduled(event, env, ctx)` handler dispatches to the same publisher the inProcess scheduler would call; the scheduler.start entry point returns immediately in workerCron mode and holds no setInterval.
acceptanceCriteria.given: scheduler-mode = workerCron and one job scheduled on cron '* * * * *'
acceptanceCriteria.then: wrangler.toml carries `[triggers] crons = ["* * * * *"]` and the Worker's scheduled handler dispatches to the publisher; scheduler.start holds no setInterval

acceptanceCriteria.description: Scheduler mode external. Given the elicited scheduler-mode answers external, when the sidecar records the answer, then the scheduler.start entry point holds no setInterval and no wrangler cron entry is emitted; the operator surface (per the operator-surface elicit) exposes a fire-now command the external cron runner (a Kubernetes CronJob, a GitHub Actions schedule, a systemd timer) invokes on its own tick; a jobScheduled event fires per invocation from the fire-now command, not from an in-process clock.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sidecar records the answer and the external cron runner invokes the fire-now command
acceptanceCriteria.then: scheduler.start holds no setInterval; no wrangler cron entry is emitted; jobScheduled fires per fire-now invocation, not per in-process tick
